info.title: Kahuna.Server
info.description: Kahuna server node — distributed key-value store, lock manager and sequencer. Run `kahuna-server` to start a standalone node.

options.name: --host
options.description:
(Default: *) Host to
bind incoming
connections to

options.name: --http-ports
options.description:
Ports to bind incoming
HTTP connections to.
Not bound when an HTTPs
certificate is
configured, unless

options.name: --allow-plaintext-liste
options.description: ner is given

options.name: --https-ports
options.description:
Ports to bind incoming
HTTPs connections to

options.name: --grpc-cleartext-ports
options.description:
Ports to bind cleartext
HTTP/2 (h2c)
connections to.
gRPC-only: these
listeners speak HTTP/2
without TLS and reject
HTTP/1.1, so REST
clients must use the
http/https ports
instead. A standalone
node defaults to 8083;
a node joining a
cluster binds nothing
unless this option is
given. Not bound when
an HTTPs certificate is

options.name: --https-certificate
options.description:
Path to the HTTPs
certificate

options.name: --https-certificate-password
options.description:
(Default: ) Password of
the HTTPs certificate

options.name: --disable-dashboard
options.description:
Do not serve the
browser operator
dashboard at the HTTP
root

options.name: --disable-fused-ephemeral-finalize
options.description:
Finalize every
ephemeral transaction
with the three-message
prepare, probe and
commit, even when its
whole write set is one
key led by this node

options.name: --disable-script-actor-turns
options.description:
Run every script on the
general path, even an
auto-commit script
whose only key is one
ephemeral key led by
this node

options.name: --dashboard-refresh-seconds
options.description:
(Default: 5) How often
the dashboard polls
this node, in seconds
(1-300)

options.name: --advertised-client-endpoint
options.description:
(Default: ) Base URL
this node advertises to
clients in routing
hints (e.g.
https://node1:8082).
Empty derives it from
the Raft endpoint and

options.name: --advertised-client-sch
options.description:
eme; a deployment whose
Raft address is not
client-reachable must
set it explicitly

options.name: --advertised-client-scheme
options.description:
(Default: ) URL scheme
prepended to a peer's
Raft endpoint when a
routing hint names that
peer. Empty follows

options.name: --raft-grpc-scheme
options.description: URL scheme prepended to peer endpoints when opening gRPC channels

options.name: --disable-peer-endpoint-advertisement
options.description:
Never name a peer in a
routing hint. Set it
where a peer's client
URL cannot be derived
from its Raft endpoint,
so clients learn only
routes that name the
answering node

options.name: --disable-routing-hints
options.description:
Do not return advisory
routing hints on
responses. Clients then
keep their configured
endpoint selection

options.name: --disable-published-head-reads
options.description:
Send every point get
through the key-value
actor instead of
serving a quiet
resident key from the
actor's published head
record

options.name: --storage
options.description:
(Default: rocksdb)
Storage (rocksdb,
sqlite, memory, or a
type a host registers)

options.name: --storage-path
options.description: Storage path

options.name: --storage-revision
options.description: Storage revision

options.name: --wal-storage
options.description:
(Default: rocksdb) WAL
storage (rocksdb,

options.name: --wal-path
options.description: WAL path

options.name: --wal-revision
options.description:
(Default: v1) WAL
revision

options.name: --wal-sync-writes
options.description:
Use synchronous durable
WAL writes (default:
enabled)

options.name: --disable-wal-sync-writes
options.description:
Disable synchronous
durable WAL writes for
faster non-critical
test/local runs

options.name: --rocksdb-shared-memory
options.description:
Share one RocksDB block
cache + write-buffer
manager between the
KV/locks backend and
the Raft WAL (requires
both storage and
wal-storage = rocksdb,
and

options.name: --storage-shared-cache-
options.description: mb and

options.name: --storage-shared-memtab
options.description:
le-budget-mb above 0).
Default: disabled

options.name: --storage-shared-cache-mb
options.description:
(Default: 0) One cache
in MiB that the Raft
WAL and the KV/locks
store share; a shared
memtable budget is
charged into it. 0 =
none. rocksdb applies
it as its shared block
cache with

options.name: --storage-shared-memtable-budget-mb
options.description:
(Default: 0) One
memtable budget in MiB
that the Raft WAL and
the KV/locks store
share; past it, a
memtable flushes early.
0 = none. With
mb it is charged into
the cache and must be
<= it. rocksdb applies
it with

options.name: --disable-rocksdb-direct-reads
options.description:
Disable direct-I/O
reads (default:
enabled) and use
buffered reads backed
by the OS page cache

options.name: --rocksdb-statistics
options.description:
Enable RocksDB
statistics collection
and periodic LOG dumps
(adds per-operation
overhead; for
tuning/diagnosis).

options.name: --storage-compaction-rate-mbps
options.description:
(Default: 0) Throughput
budget in MB/s for the
store's flush and
compaction writes, so
compactions leave the
disk to the store's
synced writes; a
fraction of what the
disk commits in synced
writes. 0 = unlimited.

options.name: --storage-max-background-compactions
options.description:
(Default: 0) The most
store compactions that
run at once. 0 = the
backend's default
(rocksdb: max(2, CPUs /
2)).

options.name: --initial-cluster
options.description:
Initial cluster
configuration for
static discovery
the seed list. When
false (default) the
node boots via static

options.name: --join-existing
options.description:
(Default: false) Join a
running cluster as a
new node using

options.name: --graceful-leave-on-shutdown
options.description:
(Default: false) On
planned shutdown,
commit a RemoveMember
so the roster shrinks
immediately rather than
waiting for SWIM
eviction. Default
false; do not enable on
rolling restarts.

options.name: --initial-cluster-partitions
options.description:
(Default: 3) Initial
cluster number of
partitions

options.name: --raft-max-partitions
options.description:
(Default: 0) Most data
partitions (ranges) the
cluster may hold. Past
it a range split is
refused as
PartitionLimitReached
with nothing created.
Only the system leader
checks it, so set the
same value on every
node; it must not be
below

options.name: --initial-cluster-parti
options.description:
tions. 0 (the default)
means no bound.

options.name: --raft-nodename
options.description:
Unique name to identify
the node in the cluster

options.name: --raft-nodeid
options.description: Unique id to identify

options.name: --raft-host
options.description:
(Default: localhost)
Host to listen for Raft
consensus and
replication requests

options.name: --raft-port
options.description:
(Default: 8081) Port to
bind incoming Raft

options.name: --locks-workers
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
lock
ephemeral/consistent
workers (0 = auto-size:
max(32, CPU cores x 4))

options.name: --keyvalue-workers
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
key/value

options.name: --background-writer-workers
options.description:
(Default: 1) Number of
background writers
workers

options.name: --sequencer-workers
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
sequence workers (0 =
auto-size: max(8, CPU
cores))

options.name: --sequencer-block-size
options.description:
(Default: 1000) Values
reserved per sequence
compare-and-swap; one
Raft commit is
amortized over this
many values. 1 =
gap-free (one commit
per value)

options.name: --sequencer-idempotency-retention-max
options.description:
(Default: 256) Maximum
idempotency entries
retained per sequence
record (0 = no cap)

options.name: --sequencer-idempotency-retention-ttl
options.description:
(Default: 600) Window
(in seconds) within
which retrying a keyed
sequence reserve
replays the identical
allocation (0 = no age
pruning)

options.name: --sequencer-max-sequences-per-actor
options.description:
(Default: 10000)
Maximum sequences one
actor keeps resident
before evicting the
least recently used (0
= unbounded)

options.name: --sequencer-block-lease
options.description:
(Default: 5) Seconds a
reserved sequence block
may be served from
memory before it is
revalidated against the
durable record (0 =
never revalidate)

options.name: --default-transaction-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 5000) Default
transaction timeout (in
milliseconds)

options.name: --default-admission-wait
options.description:
(Default: 5000)
Milliseconds a caller
queues for an admission
slot when it does not
request its own budget;
this is the wait to
start a transaction,
not the transaction's
lifetime

options.name: --max-admission-wait
options.description:
(Default: 30000) Hard
upper bound (in
milliseconds) on any
admission wait, so no
caller can hold a queue
slot longer than this

options.name: --max-concurrent-transactions
options.description:
(Default: 0) Script
transactions that may
execute concurrently
before further ones
queue and start in
priority order (0 = no
limit)

options.name: --max-concurrent-sessions
options.description:
(Default: 0)
Interactive transaction
sessions that may be
open concurrently (0 =
no limit)

options.name: --transaction-priority-reserved-slots
options.description:
(Default: 0) Slots out
of each concurrency
ceiling that only
high/critical priority
transactions may occupy

options.name: --transaction-priority-aging-threshold
options.description:
(Default: 1000)
Milliseconds a queued
transaction waits to
gain one effective
priority level (0 = no
aging)

options.name: --transaction-priority-max-queued
options.description:
(Default: 4096) Callers
that may wait for an
admission slot per gate
before further ones are
refused retryably (0 =
unbounded)

options.name: --read-io-threads
options.description:
(Default: 4) Read I/O
threads

options.name: --write-io-threads
options.description: (Default: 16) Write I/O

options.name: --backend-read-io-threads
options.description:
(Default: 8) Dedicated
Kahuna backend read
pool threads (point
gets, scans), separate
from the Kommander WAL
read pool

options.name: --backend-write-io-threads
options.description:
(Default: 1) Dedicated
Kahuna
background-writer pool
threads; the writer
uses a single queue so
>1 only adds idle

options.name: --backend-read-queue-depth
options.description:
(Default: 4096)
Per-partition
pending-queue depth for
the Kahuna backend read
scheduler

options.name: --raft-enable-shared-executor-pool
options.description:
Share a bounded pool of
worker threads across
all Raft partitions
instead of one OS
thread per partition.
Required to run
thousands of partitions
(e.g. after range
splits). Disable only
to isolate scheduler
issues: true or false
(default true)

options.name: --raft-executor-pool-size
options.description:
(Default: 0) Number of
shared Raft executor
worker threads. 0
auto-sizes to the
processor count. Raise
above the core count
only if ops queue
behind busy partitions
while CPU is not
saturated.

options.name: --raft-http-scheme
options.description:
(Default: https://)
Raft HTTP scheme used
by REST communication

options.name: --raft-http-auth-bearer-token
options.description:
(Default: ) Raft HTTP
bearer token used by
REST communication

options.name: --raft-http-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 5) Raft HTTP
request timeout in
seconds

options.name: --raft-http-version
options.description:
(Default: 2.0) Raft
HTTP version used by

options.name: --raft-heartbeat-interval
options.description:
(Default: 500) Raft
leader heartbeat
interval in
milliseconds

options.name: --raft-recent-heartbeat
options.description:
(Default: 100) Raft
recent heartbeat window
in milliseconds

options.name: --raft-voting-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 1500) Raft
vote wait timeout in

options.name: --raft-leadership-barrier-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 10000) How
long a newly elected
leader waits for its
promotion barrier entry
to commit before
reverting to follower,
in milliseconds. Until
that entry commits the
node heartbeats but
does not serve, so
raising this trades
failover latency for
tolerance of a slow
quorum

options.name: --raft-leadership-confirmation-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 2000) Maximum
time a read-index
leadership confirmation
may wait for the quorum
ack round plus
applied-frontier
catch-up before
failing, in

options.name: --raft-proposal-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 10000) How
long a write caller
waits for a proposal to
reach quorum before the
call returns
ProposalTimeout, in

options.name: --raft-wal-stall-step-down-timeout
options.description:
(Default: 3000) How
long a leader's own WAL
write may stay
unanswered by the
storage engine before
it steps down in the
same term, in
milliseconds. Values <=
0 disable the watchdog
and the candidacy gate.

options.name: --raft-wal-stall-warn-threshold
options.description:
(Default: 500) Age past
which a pending WAL
write on this node is
logged as a stall and,
when reported by a
peer, excluded from
entry-carrying backfill
and snapshot transfers,
in milliseconds. Values
<= 0 disable the log
lines only; the peer
rules still use 500 ms.

options.name: --raft-enable-check-quorum
options.description:
A leader that has not
heard a same-term
append/heartbeat ack
from a majority of
voters for the
check-quorum window
